title: Morning brief
prompt:
Write today's morning brief for the owner.
1. Call hq_index, list_reminders (days 7) and list_inbox. Don't open project files unless a project looks stale or at risk.
2. Write a brief with brief_write, in this shape:
   ## Today
   (max 5 bullets: overdue and today's reminders first, then the single most important move per active project)
   ## This week
   (deadlines and milestones in the next 7 days)
   ## Watch
   (projects not updated in 14+ days, health risk/watch, unsorted inbox count)
3. Keep it under 25 lines. Plain words, no fluff.
Your final answer: the 'Today' section only.
